page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Notes in the right margin. Running head at the top left, page number at the top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: bebit in rescripto. Antecedensc. cum tanto. de consuet. vero de jure canonum mani-festum, quo omnis consuetudo peccati nutritiva improbatur; quia irrationabilis, adeoque nulla. Atque talem consuetudinem, tale edictum expresse improbat Concilium Triden-tinum.Concil. Tridenc. sess. 25. de Reform. c. 19. Imperator, reges, duces, Principes, Marchiones, comites, & quocunque alio nomine domini temporales, qui locum ad monomachi-am in terris suis concesserint : eoBarbof. in coll. ad Concil. Tridenc. d. sess. d. c. ipso sint excommunicati; ac jurif-dictione, & dominio civitatis, ca-stri, aut loci, in quo, vel apud quem duellum fieri permiserint, quod ab ecclesiâ obtinent, privati intelligantur: & si feudalia sint, directis dominis statim acquirantur.
Quod etiam multorum Pontificum Pii 5. Gregorii 13. Clementis.8. constitutionibus fuit confirmatum; quas omnes descriptas & collectas videre licet apud Barbosam in suis col-lectaneis.

page.notes: Notes in the right margin are short references, transcribed as printed with the Concilium and Barbosa abbreviations expanded only where the printed line-break split them. "Barbof.in" and "col.ad" were joined across the line. The main text is clear. The catchword "Quod" stands on the same line as the last full line, at the right. The Greek and Latin are printed in italic where shown.
